title: Rahiman Nij Sampatti
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Nij Sampatti" where he uses the metaphor of a blooming lotus in a pond to prove that only your hard work, calibre & effort can get you through challenges.

title: Pharzi Sah
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's Doha "Pharzi Sah" where he says, if one tries to achieve something through immoral ways he would fail in doing so, therefore always be kind & righteous in your ways.

title: Bhaar Jhoki Ke
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Bhaar Jhoki Ke" where he says, ego is one of the heaviest weights that a person carries on himself and this weight of ego can lead to drowning in toxicity.

title: Rahiman Muskil Aa
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Muskil Aa" where he says, life is about choosing between truth which would lead to desertion by the world or falsehood which would lead to desertion by God.

title: Rahiman Vipda
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Vipda" where he says, sometimes short-term calamities or challenges in life are necessary as during these times we get to know our real well-wishers.

title: Rahiman Chup Hwey
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Chup Hwey" where he says, when bad days come one should sit quietly because when good days come, it does not take long to make a point.

title: Taruvar Phal Nahi
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Taruvar Phal Nahi" where he says, trees do not eat their own fruits, similarly good and gentlemen are those who accumulate wealth for the work of others.

title: Dhanya Rahim
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the expression of emotions in a wide range. He says people who do not overtly express their emotions, leave room for more interpretation, empathy and genuine compassion.

title: Rahiman Nijman
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Nijman" where he says, self-pity and soliciting for sympathy doesn't get us anywhere. It is always wise to keep our troubles with ourselves to not get ridiculed.

title: Rahiman Teen
desc: Javed Akhtar says in olden times a qasid i.e. messenger used to deliver messages across villages. People used to deliver their messages to each other through these messengers which gave rise to the essence of life.

title: Kahi Rahim
desc: Javed Akhtar takes us through various shayaris where sharab is used as a symbol to explain a concept that talks about various examples of life.

title: Rahiman Priti
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the word 'Awaaz' and its various forms, the one that we use to talk to others, the one that we raise as an opinion and the one that is within us.

title: Rahiman Dhaga Prem
desc: Javed Akhtar says every human has some thoughts and expectations from life. He further says life is a formation of various elements and is full of ups and downs while death is a destruction of these elements.

title: Rahiman Dekhi
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Dekhi" where he says, do not forget the small things in life after seeing big ones, as everything whether big or small is useful in some or the other way.

title: Roothe Sujan Maniye
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's Doha "Roothe Sujan Maniye" where he says, if your family or friends are offended, you should try your best to convince & win them back not just once but multiple times.
